intended_application: Human-agent assistance that retrieves approved knowledge and drafts replies during routine customer-support chats; a human approves every reply
organization: Harbor Support Services, a fictional incumbent outsourced contact-center provider used as a teaching scenario
business_need: Improve routine-chat handling while protecting service quality and retaining client contracts
users_stakeholders: Support agents, supervisors, enterprise clients, and clients' end customers
adoption_posture: Moderate / fast follower; considering a limited pilot, not autonomous service
capabilities_constraints: Scenario assumptions: 70% of revenue is billed by agent hour; agents use an approved knowledge base; no measured local productivity or renewal data yet; human approval is required
risk_consequence_context: Incorrect drafts could mislead customers or breach client promises; human review and escalation are available
management_question: Should management pilot agent assistance and prepare for possible pressure on its hourly-pricing model?
additional_context: All Harbor details are hypothetical test assumptions, not claims about a real company. Potential alternative pricing is per resolved case or service outcome; no client has yet requested it. Compare current workflow and unit economics before claiming displacement.
